zh-CN.text: 述格支持字幕、表格与图像字幕之间的互转，以及空白口述稿自动打轴。选择文件后，转换类型下拉框会根据文件格式自动列出可用选项。

en.text: ScriptGrid converts between subtitles, spreadsheets, and image-based subtitles, and can auto-time blank narration scripts. After you pick a file, the conversion-type dropdown lists the options available for that format.

rows: ASS to SRT ｜ Subtitle to Excel ｜ Auto Narration Timing
Subtitle to Excel ｜ Auto Narration Timing
SUP to SRT ｜ SUP to Excel ｜ Auto Narration Timing

items: ASS 转 SRT：将 .ass 字幕转换为通用的 .srt 格式。
字幕转表格：将 .ass 或 .srt 字幕导出为 Excel 表格，包含「序号、开始时间、结束时间、字幕内容」四列，便于逐条校对与编辑。
ASS to SRT: convert .ass subtitles to the universal .srt format, preserving line breaks and formatting.
Subtitle to Excel: export .ass or .srt subtitles to a spreadsheet with four columns (Index, Start Time, End Time, Text) for easy line-by-line proofreading and editing.

zh-CN.text: 将 .xlsx 表格转换回 .srt 字幕。为保证正确解析，表格需满足以下要求：

items: 首行表头必须依次为：序号、开始时间、结束时间、字幕内容（仅校验前 4 列，之后多余的空列会被忽略）。
字幕数据从表头的下一行开始填写，空行会被自动跳过。
时间格式需要与「字幕转表格」导出的表格保持一致，否则会出现转换得到的字幕无法使用，或出现未知错误。

en.text: Convert an .xlsx spreadsheet back into .srt subtitles. For correct parsing, the spreadsheet must meet these requirements:

items: The header row must be, in order: Index, Start Time, End Time, Text (only the first 4 columns are validated; extra trailing columns are ignored).
Subtitle data starts from the row right after the header; blank rows are skipped automatically.
The time format must match the spreadsheet exported by "Subtitle to Excel"; otherwise the resulting subtitles may be unusable or unexpected errors may occur.

zh-CN.text: 针对 .sup（PGS）图像字幕，述格通过 OCR 识别画面中的文字并生成 SRT 或 Excel。

items: 字幕语言默认为「自动检测」；若明确知道字幕的语言，可在「字幕语言」下拉框手动指定语言以提升识别准确率。
支持简体/繁体中文、英语、日语、韩语、泰语、阿拉伯语、印地语、孟加拉语、泰米尔语、泰卢固语、卡纳达语、德语、法语、俄语、西里尔字母等。
识别为异步处理，页面会实时显示帧进度与已识别字幕数量；耗时取决于字幕数量，请耐心等待。

en.text: For .sup (PGS) image-based subtitles, ScriptGrid uses OCR to recognize the on-screen text and generate SRT or Excel output.

items: Subtitle language defaults to "Auto Detect"; if you already know the subtitle language, manually select it in the "Subtitle Language" dropdown to improve recognition accuracy.
Supported languages include Simplified/Traditional Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, Thai, Arabic, Hindi, Bengali, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, German, French, Russian, Cyrillic, and more.
Recognition runs asynchronously; the page shows live frame progress and the number of recognized subtitles. Processing time depends on the subtitle count, so please be patient.

zh-CN.text: 本功能可帮助口述影像创作者对空白的口述稿一键完成时间轴标注，后续撰稿时，只需根据实际情况微调时间即可。上传 .ass / .srt / .sup 文件后选择该功能，述格会基于对白字幕智能推算出没有对白的片段，然后自动生成带占位文本的口述稿条目，最终输出一份标准 srt 文件。

items: 生成的口述稿与前后对白之间保持 500 毫秒间隔，单条最短持续 1 秒。
超过 30 秒的超长空白段会被等分为多段，子段之间同样保持 500 毫秒间隔，避免单条时长过长。
生成后可将表格中的占位文本替换为实际口述内容。

en.text: This feature helps audio description creators annotate the timeline of a blank narration script in one click, so that when writing later you only need to fine-tune the timings as needed. Upload an .ass / .srt / .sup file and select this feature; based on the dialogue subtitles, ScriptGrid intelligently infers the segments that have no dialogue, then automatically generates placeholder narration entries and finally outputs a standard .srt file.

items: Generated narration keeps a 500 ms gap from the surrounding dialogue, and each entry lasts at least 1 second.
Blank segments longer than 30 seconds are split evenly into multiple entries, each also separated by a 500 ms gap, to avoid overly long single entries.
After generation, replace the placeholder text in the spreadsheet with your actual narration.
时间轴校验：若输入字幕存在时间重叠或乱序，转换会被中断并提示错误，请先修正字幕后重试。
处理期间请勿关闭或刷新页面，否则正在进行的任务会被中断（页面会弹出提醒）。
界面语言：点击右上角按钮可在中文与 English 之间切换，选择会被自动记住。
Timeline validation: if input subtitles overlap or are out of order, the conversion is blocked with an error. Fix the subtitles and try again.
Do not close or refresh the page while processing, or the running task will be interrupted (a confirmation dialog will appear).
Interface language: use the button in the top-right corner to switch between Chinese and English; your choice is remembered.
